seed: Overcooked the pasta for dinner

# I Overcooked the Pasta and Won at Life

I failed at dinner last night.

Publicly.

In front of my own kitchen.

I'm not afraid to say it.

The pasta was soft.

My resolve was not.

Here's what it taught me about leadership:

🍝 Al dente is a mindset, not a cooking time.

🔥 Fail fast, drain faster.

💡 A true leader eats the mushy pasta first so the team doesn't have to.

✅ Excellence is just disappointment with a strong personal brand.

I'm just a simple man with a colander and a dream.

Humbled.

Grateful.

Slightly full.

#Leadership #Humbled #Pasta #Growth #Authenticity
